State Laws
Complete Streets legislation (Public Acts 134
and 135 of 2010) gives new project planning
and coordination responsibilities to city, county
and state transportation agencies across
Michigan. The legislation defines Complete
Streets as: “roadways planned, designed,
and constructed to provide appropri-
ate access to all legal users... whether by
car, truck, transit, assistive device, foot or
bicycle.”
